poses.caption: Lie on your back with arms out, cross one bent knee toward the opposite side and keep both shoulders grounded

jobs.detail: LYING CROSSOVER STRETCH, ONE STATIC HOLD, one person only. Elevated FRONT three-quarter view on white floor, head IMAGE LEFT feet IMAGE RIGHT. Lie SUPINE with head, upper back and BOTH SHOULDER BLADES resting FLAT floor; BOTH arms stretched out sideways at shoulder level in a T, palms up relaxed, both hands fully visible. LEFT leg remains STRAIGHT along floor. Bend RIGHT hip/knee about90degrees and bring RIGHT knee ACROSS torso midline toward LEFT side, gently lowering crossed right knee toward floor on opposite side. Pelvis rotates left gently but BOTH shoulders remain grounded, chest stays facing UP, not a full side roll. Right lower leg relaxed, right foot follows bent knee across near left thigh, do not lock knees together or twist ankle; no figure-four, no hand pulling knee. Turn head gently toward right outstretched arm if comfortable, neutral neck. Primary RIGHT GLUTE/outer hip region stretched is a faint soft DIFFUSE red COLOR TINT on intact BLACK shorts fabric over right buttock/outerhip only, no muscle pattern, no red waist/arms/bottomleg. Fully opaque shorts wrap FRONT, sides, BACK, seat and crotch even in rotated pelvis; no rear cutaway, buttock skin or groin gap. Entire person including BOTH T-shaped arms, all fingers/feet inside spacious white margins.
